title: Putting the evidence together
caption: An unknown with M⁺ at 88 (C₄H₈O₂), a strong IR absorption at 1740 cm⁻¹ but no broad O–H, and ¹H NMR peaks at 1.3 (t, 3H), 2.0 (s, 3H) and 4.1 (q, 2H) is ethyl ethanoate. Each technique narrows the possibilities.
alt: A flow: mass spectrum gives the formula, IR the functional group, NMR the arrangement, leading to the structure.
description: IR: C=O at 1740 cm⁻¹, no O–H: an ester.
NMR: an ethyl group next to O and a CH₃ next to C=O.
